result.detail:
Choices and deviations:
(1) No formal_spec (.sby) is submitted. The expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench, and an unbounded proof I cannot run myself is a risky gate. As a result, req:AXIL-FORMAL from [artifact:prj-f3241395ae.interface-spec.a1] is not met by this task. The design-intent properties in the RTL are ready for a later .sby, which needs a follow-up task or owner. The failure-path testbench axi4_lite_regs_tb_fail.v listed in the microarchitecture plan is also not delivered here.
(2) The holding registers (aw_addr_q, w_data_q, w_strb_q) are not reset, as section 2 of [artifact:prj-f3241395ae.microarchitecture.a1] specifies. They are read only when their reset 'held' flags are set.
(3) A read accepted on the same edge as a write to the same register returns the old value. The testbench model expects this; the spec does not define the case.
(4) Both files carry `timescale 1ns/1ps`. This avoids Verilator's TIMESCALEMOD error when the files are compiled together.
Independent review is still required, and lint, simulation and synthesis must run first.
